baseline_models.reading: The focus states that the human was brought into being from ʿalaq, ordinarily construed here as a clot or congealed-blood substance; the creator is grammatically implicit inside the focus itself.

focus_anchor.role: The whole focus supplies the creation event, the human object, and the source construction with مِنْ.

activation_trace.role: The supplied image of originating and bringing into being gives خَلَقَ its ordinary creation force.
The supplied scope explicitly includes thick or congealed blood and a piece of it, supporting the ordinary clot construal of عَلَقٍ.

baseline_models.mechanism: Ordinary syntax reads خَلَقَ with ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ as its object and مِنْ عَلَقٍ as the material or source from which that creation proceeds.
baseline_models.reader_inference: No extra causal sequence is needed beyond the focus syntax. Selecting the clot branch is a packet-supported lexical construal, not a claim that it exhausts عَلَقٍ; the focus alone does not name the implicit subject.
baseline_models.containment: Retain this as the ordinary reading without importing a detailed embryological timetable or treating one unranked branch as the root's only sense.

baseline_models.reading: Alongside the clot reading, the focus can profile human formation from something that clings and a conception that has taken hold: origin is pictured as attachment rather than self-standing autonomy.

focus_anchor.role: The source phrase permits the supplied clinging and conception-taking-hold images to qualify the human's beginning.

activation_trace.role: The image of measuring and proportioning permits creation to be heard as formation, not only bare origination.
The branch's central image is something clinging, sticking, or hanging on another thing.
The supplied conception-taking-hold scope makes a generative attachment a locally apt co-reading.

baseline_models.mechanism: The source construction joins a formation verb to a noun whose mapped inventory contains both attachment and conception taking hold, yielding a process image that coexists with the material clot gloss.
baseline_models.reader_inference: The packet supplies proportioning, clinging, and conception; combining them into one origin-process is reader synthesis from خَلَقَ ... مِنْ. The clot/congealed-blood construal remains fully live.
baseline_models.containment: Use this as a lexical contour, not as a technical account of reproduction, and do not turn attachment into a moral judgment before context supplies one.

context_deltas.reading: The preceding ayah identifies the focus's implicit creator as 'your Lord' and places human origin inside the command to read in His name: creation becomes the authority-frame for reading, not an isolated origin notice.

focus_anchor.role: The focus specifies what the Creator-Lord has created and from what.

activation_trace.role: The ordinary reading/reciting image supplies the act commanded immediately before the focus.
The lordship, ownership, and authority image identifies the relation under which reading and creation are placed.
The first خَلَقَ supplies the generic creation predicate that the focus immediately repeats and specifies.

structural_cues.role: Imperative, name phrase, Lord relation, and relative creation clause form the first end of the cross-ayah sequence.
Repetition of خَلَقَ across the boundary resolves the implicit subject by continuity and particularizes creation as human origin.

context_deltas.mechanism: Adjacent repetition of خَلَقَ carries the named رَبِّكَ from the relative clause into the focus, while the imperative ٱقْرَأْ makes that creation claim the immediate setting for commanded reading.

changed_reading.before: The focus alone states human origin from ʿalaq while leaving the creator implicit.
changed_reading.after: The creator is identified as the addressee's Lord, and human origin becomes the authority-bearing frame within which reading in His name is commanded.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The subject identification follows the adjacent grammar and repeated verb. Calling creation a warrant for reading is a directional reading of the sequence; it may also be heard more minimally as praise or identification of the Lord.
context_deltas.containment: Do not erase the focus's material-origin assertion or claim that the text explicitly states a formal premise-and-conclusion argument.

context_deltas.reading: Ayat 3–5 turn the materially created human into the taught human: recitation, the pen, and the movement from not knowing to knowing add epistemic reception to the focus's account of creaturely formation.

focus_anchor.role: The created human named here is repeated as the recipient of teaching in 96:5.

activation_trace.role: The repeated reading/reciting imperative resumes the activity that surrounds the creation statement.
The trimmed writing reed or pen image specifies a material means associated with teaching.
The complete occurrence covers both عَلَّمَ and يَعْلَمْ; the branch supplies teaching and knowing as a thing becoming clear.

structural_cues.role: This is the creation end of the repeated-human relation.
The renewed imperative transitions from origin to the Lord's generosity and instruction.
Teaching by the pen provides the intervening means.
Exact repetition of ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ makes the created human the taught human and contrasts prior nonknowledge with acquired knowledge.

context_deltas.mechanism: Noun repetition links 96:2 and 96:5, while the intervening teaching/pen clauses construct a sequence from material formation to received knowledge.

changed_reading.before: The focus presents the human chiefly through material source and formation.
changed_reading.after: The same human is presented as both formed from ʿalaq and formed epistemically through teaching, reading, and the pen.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The lexical and sequential links are packet-supplied; describing them as a paired anthropology is reader synthesis. The sequence does not say that every kind of knowledge comes through writing or establish a biological chronology.
context_deltas.containment: Keep material creation and teaching distinct but coordinated; do not reduce one to a metaphor for the other.

context_deltas.reading: Ayat 6–8 make the focus a rebuke to imagined autonomy: the human whose beginning is from clinging matter transgresses when he sees himself self-sufficient, although his return is to the same Lord who created him.

focus_anchor.role: The clinging source image gives a concrete beginning against which claimed self-sufficiency can be tested.

activation_trace.role: The focus branch supplies the image of something clinging to and dependent on another thing.
Overstepping the proper bound in rebellion supplies the human response that the origin claim now diagnoses.
The self-sufficiency and lack-of-need image names the perception explicitly associated with transgression.
Return to a prior source or state supplies the terminal counter to imagined independence.
Lordship and ownership identify the endpoint of return and restore the relation first stated in 96:1.

structural_cues.role: The created-from-clinging-origin claim is the first end of the contrast.
Exact repetition of ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ carries the focus's human into the transgression statement.
This clause explicitly connects the transgression to seeing oneself self-sufficient.
The asserted return to the Lord closes the autonomy claim from the opposite direction.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repetition of 'the human' and the sequence origin → self-perceived sufficiency → transgression → return create a semantic clash between creaturely attachment and asserted independence.

changed_reading.before: The clinging or clot-like source describes how human life begins.
changed_reading.after: That beginning becomes evidence against the human's perception of being without need, and the stated return encloses the whole attempted autonomy.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The causal link between perceived sufficiency and transgression is explicit in 96:6–7. Reading dependence out of عَلَقٍ uses the supplied clinging image; if عَلَقٍ is heard only as clot, creation and return still bracket the autonomy claim without that sharper lexical contrast.
context_deltas.containment: Do not infer that attachment itself is blameworthy or that material smallness automatically produces virtue; the criticism targets self-perception and transgressive conduct.

context_deltas.reading: Ayat 9–14 unfold the focus's generic human into opposed postures—prohibiting prayer and denying/turning away versus prayer, guidance, and protective piety—while divine seeing makes conduct, not mere created status, the axis of accountability.

focus_anchor.role: The species-level human named in the focus is the category whose divergent actions the following interrogation exposes.

activation_trace.role: The restraining-from-an-act image identifies the coercive posture of the one who forbids.
The prescribed worship image identifies the act being obstructed.
Protective moral self-guarding supplies the positive content of تَّقْوَىٰٓ.
Falsehood against truth supplies one side of the explicit negative alternative.
Turning away and withdrawal supplies the second side of the negative alternative.
Seeing by eye or insight gives the final accountability clause its observing force.

structural_cues.role: The interrogative directs attention to a person defined by prohibition.
The prohibited object is a servant precisely when he prays.
Guidance is posed as a live positive condition without resolving the pronoun's referent by itself.
Commanding protective piety completes the positive alternative.
Denial and withdrawal supply the opposed alternative.
Knowledge that Allah sees places the contrasted behavior under observation.

context_deltas.mechanism: A chain of interrogatives and conditional alternatives shifts the generic created human from a statement of origin to a field of accountable relations: one forbids, one prays, guidance and piety stand opposite denial and withdrawal, and Allah sees.

changed_reading.before: The focus speaks of the human generically and materially, without differentiating conduct.
changed_reading.after: Created status is shared background, while the context differentiates humans by worship, coercion, guidance, protection, denial, and withdrawal under divine seeing.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The behavioral opposition and divine seeing are supplied by the text. The precise referent of كَانَ and أَمَرَ in 96:11–12 remains materially live: they may continue one participant or pose a counterfactual about another; this reading retains the opposition without deciding that syntax.
context_deltas.containment: Do not claim that material origin causes either conduct, do not settle the 96:11–12 referent, and do not turn the passage into a taxonomy of fixed human essences.

context_deltas.reading: The final ayah turns the focus's created human form into an embodied answer: refuse the prohibitor's claim, lower the created body in prostration, and use that lowering as devotional approach.

focus_anchor.role: Creation of the human supplies the formed agent whose obedience and bodily posture are commanded at the window's end.

activation_trace.role: The complete, visible, well-proportioned form image permits the creation statement to foreground embodied human form.
Pliant obedience supplies what the prohibition لَا تُطِعْهُ refuses to grant the human obstructer.
Lowering in humble submission supplies the posture and relational reversal of ٱسْجُدْ.
The prostration-limbs image makes explicit the bodily materiality through which the response is enacted.
Devotional approach and seeking nearness supply an apt scope for ٱقْتَرِب beside prostration.

structural_cues.role: The focus provides the formed-from-matter beginning of the embodied sequence.
A prohibition followed by two imperatives directs allegiance, bodily lowering, and nearness as the terminal response.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ending's coordinated commands reverse the transgressor's attempted control: the human body created from ʿalaq does not yield to him but lowers in worship and thereby approaches.

changed_reading.before: The focus describes the body's material formation and says nothing yet about what that formed human does.
changed_reading.after: Created embodiment becomes an arena of allegiance: its culminating posture is humble prostration oriented toward devotional nearness rather than obedience to the prohibitor.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies formed shape, obedience, prostration limbs, humble lowering, and devotional approach. Calling this the created body's answer is synthesis from the window's arc, not an explicit claim that 96:2 states creation's sole purpose; general nearness remains a live shade beside devotional nearness.
context_deltas.containment: Do not infer anatomical design arguments or collapse all human embodiment into ritual posture; retain this as the terminal contextual activation of the focus.

surprising_valid_outliers.reading: A contained bodily reversal links the focus to 96:15–16: the human's source-material is something that clings, but the transgressing human later becomes the one seized at a graspable forelock described as lying and culpably wrong.

focus_anchor.role: The focus supplies the initial attachment image whose direction is later imaginatively reversed.

activation_trace.role: Something clinging, sticking, or hanging on another supplies the origin-side image.
Seizing by the forelock with coercive force supplies the later grasping action.
The forelock and taking or pulling it supply the concrete hold-point.

structural_cues.role: The human begins from clinging material.
The threat makes the forelock the object of seizure.
The next ayah appositionally characterizes that same forelock by falsehood and culpable wrong.

surprising_valid_outliers.mechanism: A cross-domain reversal of attachment changes who or what holds: at origin the material clings; under judgment the morally described human is grasped by a bodily extremity.

changed_reading.before: Attachment belongs only to the source-material from which the human is created.
changed_reading.after: The later seizure permits an exploratory arc in which the creature that began through attachment is itself rendered graspable and non-autonomous.

surprising_valid_outliers.reader_inference: The packet supplies both attachment and forelock-seizure images, but their reciprocal arrangement is reader-supplied. A materially live alternative is that these are unrelated bodily descriptions with no intended echo.
surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses from generative material to punitive bodily control. Keep it exploratory, do not claim lexical identity between عَلَق and سفع/ناصية, and do not say the focus predicts punishment.

summary.ordinary_reading: Within the window, the Lord named in 96:1 is the implicit creator: He created the human from ʿalaq, ordinarily a clinging clot or congealed-blood substance.
coexisting_readings: The same focus can foreground attachment and conception taking hold, with creation heard as measured formation; this complements rather than replaces the clot reading.
The created human becomes the taught human through reading, the pen, and movement from nonknowledge to knowledge.
Clinging origin and eventual return make self-perceived sufficiency unstable and expose transgression as a creature's overstepping.
The generic created human is contextually differentiated by prayer, guidance, protective piety, prohibition, denial, and withdrawal under divine seeing.
At the window's close, created embodiment becomes a vehicle of noncompliance with the prohibitor, humble prostration, and devotional nearness.
Exploratorily, the clinging source and the later seized forelock form a reversal from attachment at origin to creaturely graspability.
unresolved_limits: The packet records no source gaps and no out-of-window orientation ayat; no claim here relies on non-citable orientation.
Root mappings and their branches are supplied without ranking, so a cited branch establishes an available image, not exclusive or automatically intended primacy.
The referent of the positive conditional in 96:11–12 remains unresolved; the ethical contrast survives without assigning it decisively.
The window does not provide a detailed biological chronology, and lexical images of clot, clinging, conception, and formation should not be converted into one.
The clinging/seizure reversal is a contained exploratory analogy, not a demonstrated lexical or compositional equation.
